I am incredibly proud to earn the DFL endorsement!

I promise to continue fighting for our values no matter what they throw at us. Onward to the primary! 💪🏽

Video

Teachers deserve living wages.

Robbinsdale teachers have been working without a contract for over 300 days. 

The district must get serious and treat our teachers with the dignity and respect they deserve.

I was proud to stand with them in their fight for a fair contract. ✊🏽

Video

This unhinged rant would solicit anger if it wasn’t coming from a criminal, who has 34 felony convictions, held accountable for rape and accused of being a pedo. I still don’t know how anyone would willingly humiliate themselves like this but here we are. Btw, the pedophile protection party should find new material for their deflection 💁🏽‍♀️


Aaron Rupar (@atrupar)

If we truly believe in putting human rights at the center of our foreign policy we cannot enable human rights abuses.

The U.S. and Gulf allies could help end Sudan’s war, but instead we enable weapons to reach the genocidal RSF, prolonging immense suffering. We can’t be credible peacemakers while fueling conflict.

Video

The Iran War has cost the U.S. over $25 billion so far. 

Our taxes shouldn't pay for murdering school children, decimating towns, displacing millions of civilians, and fueling generational devastation.

Our tax dollars should invest in the needs of working people, not war.

Congratulations @Liban4congress on winning the Democratic nomination in UT-01. 🥳

Join me in supporting his people-powered campaign!


Liban Mohamed (@Liban4congress)

Proud to have the endorsement of Rep. Ilhan Omar, a fearless voice for justice.

This campaign is about vision over fear. People over profit. No corporate PACs. No special or corporate interests, just a movement powered by everyday people.

When Donald Trump attacks our communities, we do not shrink. We rise. We organize. We serve
